findings.body: The invalid UTF-8 record precedes the final qualifying Claude turn. Because from_transcript scans backward and returns immediately on that turn, it never parses these bytes. Narrowing _line_model's exception handler from Exception to json.JSONDecodeError would therefore survive this test: trailing empty lines would still be handled, but a trailing UnicodeDecodeError would escape to from_transcript's outer handler and discard the usable model.
findings.consequence: A regression handling partially written UTF-8 transcript tails can pass the suite and make seat composition drop Claude reviewers.

findings.body: The test seeds and checks only HM.SESSION_ENV_VARS, which is also the list production iterates. Replacing HOST_MODEL_ENV with a duplicate TRANSCRIPT_ENV in that tuple would preserve its length of three and leave this test green: the real host-model variable would never enter the fixture. The hook exports the three individual constants independently, so that mutant would leave a real parent variable unscrubbed.
findings.consequence: A wrong-key or duplicate-key regression in the scrub list could escape this test and let a child inherit its parent's host identity.
